The weighted cloud reliability calculator passed all tests with a perfect reward score, demonstrating a robust initial implementation.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.76 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.207s. While the logic is functional, future iterations should re-check edge case handling for zero-weight inputs to ensure the weighted mean calculation remains stable.
